name: Hajimeru Sekai no Risouron -goodbye world index-
original_name: はじめるセカイの理想論 -goodbye world index-
source:
This isn't the world you know.

The protagonist, a boy named Shin Onomiya, is one amongst those reincarnated here upon answering the summons of the God who rules this world.

"I want you to lead this world to the right path."

He was entrusted with the fate of this warped world. Alongside him are his partners who were also summoned from other worlds. While fighting shadowy apparitions dubbed 'the enemies of the world', somehow they manage to lead a peaceful and lively existence.

This boy's heart is wounded. The world he once lived in was brimming with lies, and those lies are what killed him.

When reincarnated into this world, he was granted by God the ability known as 'Doubt', which allows him to see through the lies of others. Never again shall he allow himself to be hurt by lies.

Yet this power also revealed to him the inner selves of his comrades. Things they were hiding deep inside, things they were running away from. Feeling the wounds borne by these girls, awkwardly yet steadily the distance between them shrank.

Everyday, the 'End Index' counts down to the end of the world.

Having lost the places they once belonged to, carrying their own ideals of 'how things should have been' hidden in their hearts, the summoned boy and girls change the shape of this world with their feelings.

Beyond the end.

Towards an ideal world.

[Translated from [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/hajiron/story/]Official Site[/url]]
